citation.source_text: Revenue of 26 billion was up 18% sequentially and up 262% year on year and well above our outlook of 24 billion.

claims.claim: Nvidia reported Q1 fiscal 2025 revenue of $26 billion, up 18% sequentially and 262% year over year, above its $24 billion outlook.

citation.source_text: Okay, moving to the rest of the P&L, gap growth margin expanded sequentially to 78.4% and non-gap growth margins to 78.9% on lower inventory charges.

claims.claim: GAAP gross margin rose sequentially to 78.4%, and non-GAAP gross margin to 78.9%, with lower inventory charges.

citation.source_text: Moving to automotive, revenue was 329 million, up 17% sequentially and up 11% year on year.

claims.claim: Automotive revenue was $329 million, up 17% sequentially and 11% year‑over‑year.

citation.source_text: sequentially, gap operating expenses were up 10% and non-gap operating expenses were up 13%, primarily reflecting higher compensation-related costs and increased compute and infrastructure investments.

claims.claim: GAAP operating expenses rose 10% sequentially and non-GAAP operating expenses rose 13%, mainly reflecting higher compensation costs and compute and infrastructure investments.

citation.source_text: Moving to gaming and AI PCs, gaming revenue of $2.65 billion was down 8% sequentially and up 18% year-on-year consistent with our outlook for a seasonal decline.

claims.claim: Gaming revenue was $2.65 billion, down 8% sequentially and up 18% year over year, consistent with Nvidia’s earlier outlook for a seasonal decline.

citation.source_text: Our data center revenue in China is down significantly from the level prior to the imposition of the new export control restrictions in October.

claims.claim: Nvidia said its China Data Center revenue was significantly below the level before new export-control restrictions in October.

overall_summary: Nvidia reported Q1 fiscal 2025 revenue of $26 billion, up 18% sequentially and 262% year over year, above the $24 billion outlook stated in its previous call. GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 78.4% and 78.9%, respectively, while corresponding operating expenses rose 10% and 13% sequentially. Gaming revenue fell 8% sequentially to $2.65 billion, and Nvidia said China Data Center revenue remained significantly below the level before the October export-control restrictions. The earlier-call excerpts provide business context, not evidence of a change in an executive’s communication.
